Conferences, lectures and seminars

  1. 5 November 2026

    Indian History Congress moves its 85th session to Puducherry, February 2027

    The annual meeting of Indian historians will not take place in Bengaluru in December. It now runs from 26 to 28 February 2027 at Tagore Government Arts and Science College, and papers are due by 7 February.

    When: 26 February 2027 to 28 February 2027 · Where: Tagore Government Arts and Science College, Puducherry · Apply by: 7 February 2027

Jobs, fellowships, courses and calls

  1. 7 November 2026

    American Institute of Indian Studies fellowships for research in India close on 19 November

    AIIS is taking applications for three fellowships that fund research trips to India: one for doctoral students, one for senior scholars and one for early-career scholars. The deadline is 19 November 2026.

    Apply by: 19 November 2026

  2. 6 November 2026

    Sagar university seeks a contract curator for its archaeology department

    Dr Harisingh Gour Vishwavidyalaya is offering one curator post at Rs 40,000 a month, on a contract of up to 12 months. Online applications close on 30 November 2026.

    Where: Sagar, Madhya Pradesh · Apply by: 30 November 2026

  3. 6 November 2026

    Rice University advertises its endowed professorship in Jain Studies

    The Tirthankar Shantinath Professorship in Houston is open at assistant level, with associate level and tenure possible for qualified candidates. Materials should arrive by 15 November 2026 for fullest consideration.

    Where: Houston, Texas, USA · Apply by: 15 November 2026

  4. 5 November 2026

    University of Zurich seeks a professor of the cultural history of India

    The open-rank post, described as premodern Indology with the specialisation left open, is at the Institute of Asian and Oriental Studies. It starts on 1 August 2028 and closes to applications on 7 December 2026.

    Where: Zurich, Switzerland · Apply by: 7 December 2026
